newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Arvind Mills to raise $75 mln.
newsitem.headline: India's Arvind Mills to raise $75 mln.

text.p: India's Arvind Mills, one of the world's top denim makers, plans to raise a $75 million loan, a top official of Bank of Nova Scotia in Bombay said on Tuesday.
"We intend to come into the market in the next few weeks," Bhaskar Desai, vice president and manager of Bank of Nova Scotia, lead manager of the syndicated loan, told Reuters.
He said Arvind Mills will use the funds for capital expenditure programme. Arvind Mills officials were not immediately available for comment.
Desai said the bank has been helping some of India's leading corporates in accessing the foreign currency loan market.
Earlier this year, Bank of Nova Scotia lead managed and underwrote a $75 million loan for India's leading truck maker Tata Engineering and Locomotive Company Ltd.
The bank also jointly led a $115 million loan offering by construction and engineering giant Larsen & Toubro, Desai said.
